chunks: Everything in this book that is narrated from ʿAbdullāh ibn Jundub has been transmitted by me from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from his father, from ʿAbdullāh ibn Jundub.

key_terms.أَبِيهِ: his father, referring to the preceding narrator’s father in the chain
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: an honorific supplication meaning may Allah be pleased with him
key_terms.عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جُنْدَبٍ: the narrator from whom these reports are transmitted

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAbdullāh ibn Jundub in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from ʿAbdullāh ibn Jundub in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission and preserving hadith-source attribution.
